name: banking
description: Agent-safe banking control plane for Hasna infrastructure and AI agents. Ships intent, policy, and provider types plus CLI and MCP surfaces; production storage is supplied by the host through the BankingCoreStore interface. SQLite at the effective banking data home (~/.hasna/banking/banking.db by default, resolved via @hasna/paths; the XDG data home is adopted only once the store is migrated there or HASNA_DATA_HOME is set).

waivedStorageEngines.reason: The bundled SQLite adapter is a development fixture that defaults to a file-backed database at the canonical package data root ~/.hasna/banking/banking.db (HASNA_BANKING_HOME overrides the root); hosts supply production storage, PostgreSQL included, through the BankingCoreStore interface in src/core/store.ts.
